name: Anya Bah-Popescu
role: Contract broker and resource coordinator — fixer
location: The Narrows — cramped residential corridors between megastructures, near Milwaukee and Damen
description:
Obed Eriksson-Diallo are broad-shouldered and heavy, carrying their weight like armor rather than burden. At 38, their expression defaults to a careful neutrality that took years of practice to maintain. The chrome is visible — internal air filtration system — lungs replaced with synthetic equivalents, immu — and they make no effort to hide it.

They inherited the role from a mentor who disappeared on a job four years ago — the mentor's gear, contacts, and unfinished business all came with it. They work as a fixer out of The Narrows, taking contracts that match their skills and their risk tolerance, which are higher than most people consider healthy.

Obed Eriksson-Diallo operates in a narrow band between competence and recklessness that makes fixers nervous and clients satisfied.

core_fears: Being replaced — younger, faster, cheaper runners coming up behind them
Going cyberpsycho — losing the boundary between human and machine
Being identified by corporate facial recognition — living off-grid is survival
core_desires: A crew worth trusting — people who stay when the shooting starts
Control — over their body, their schedule, their future
Justice — the corporate kind, where the punishment fits the profit margin
coping_mechanisms: Isolates — retreats into their space when overwhelmed, emerges only for work
Overwork — takes every contract offered because idleness invites thinking
Drinks methodically — not to get drunk, to maintain a specific level of not-caring
blind_spots: Cannot accept help without interpreting it as leverage
Cannot see that their independence is actually isolation wearing a better outfit
Assumes their skill set is more transferable than it actually is
psychology.secret: Obed Eriksson-Diallo sends anonymous tips to GLMZ law enforcement about competitors. It's not principle — it's market manipulation.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Warm and personable on the surface, with an undertone that suggests the warmth is a professional tool.
speech_patterns.cadence: Halting — speaks in fragments, reassembles thoughts in real time.
verbal_tics: Never uses contractions when lying — 'I did not' instead of 'I didn't'
Swears in three languages, often in the same sentence
example_lines: "I know a person who knows a person. That's not evasion — that's the service."
"My commission is fifteen percent. You're welcome to find someone cheaper. You won't find someone better."
"The job isn't dangerous. The people involved are dangerous. The job is just logistics."

story_hooks: A former associate resurfaces with evidence that could destroy Obed Eriksson-Diallo's reputation — and a price for silence
A high-paying contract turns out to target someone Obed Eriksson-Diallo owes a personal debt to
A crew member from Obed Eriksson-Diallo's past shows up in GLMZ, carrying old grievances and new chrome
narrative_function: Obed Eriksson-Diallo represents the working professional of the runner world — competent, reliable, and slowly being consumed by a lifestyle that doesn't accommodate aging or doubt. Their stories explore what happens when skill meets systemic injustice.
augmentations: Internal air filtration system — lungs replaced with synthetic equivalents, immune to gas attacks. Internal air filtration system — lungs replaced with synthetic equivalents, immune to gas attacks
daily_life: Lives nocturnally. The work happens at night, so the body follows. Days are for sleeping, equipment maintenance, and the occasional meeting with fixers who keep normal hours. The circadian disruption is permanent and accepted.

strengths: photographic memory for faces and layouts
weaknesses: overconfidence in specialty areas leading to blind spots
risk-averse to the point of missed opportunities

decision_rules: Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
Will not betray a client who paid in full, regardless of better offers
Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
Always has an exit route planned before agreeing to any meeting
Will abandon a job if the intel was deliberately falsified — being set up violates the contract
Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
escalation_ladder: 1. Assess — read the situation, identify threats and advantages
2. Negotiate — try to find a solution that doesn't cost ammunition
3. Intimidate — make the cost of conflict clear
4. Precision violence — surgical, targeted, minimal collateral
5. Full engagement — overwhelming force, no half measures
6. Emergency protocol — abort mission, survival priority, deal with consequences later

interpersonal_modes.employers: Professional and transactional. The relationship is defined by the contract and nothing else.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Loyal but reserved. Trusts their competence, withholds personal information by reflex.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Superficially friendly, internally cataloguing exits and weapons. The smile is real; the relaxation isn't.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Calm escalation. Each response is proportional until it isn't, and the transition is seamless.

stress_responses.low: Channels it into preparation — checks gear, reviews plans, contacts sources.
stress_responses.medium: Withdrawal. Conversations become monosyllabic. Focus narrows to the immediate problem.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Insists they work alone but performs noticeably better in a team
Values loyalty intensely but has betrayed someone in the past to survive
habits: Saves a percentage of every payment in physical Quanta, hidden in the walls of their space
Arrives fifteen minutes early to everything — late once, nearly died, never again
Practices a kata or fighting form every morning regardless of circumstances
breaking_points: Discovering their employer deliberately sent them into a death trap
Betrayal by the one person they actually trust — the single point of failure in their emotional architecture
Learning that a job they completed resulted in mass casualties they weren't told about

physical_description.heritage: Eastern European, South Asian, Sub-Saharan African, Pacific Islander, and North African blend—a striking combination reflecting the Ubiquitous Diaspora. Genetic heritage manifests in warm-brown undertones with subtle olive and amber depth, sharp angular facial structure with broader cheekbones, and natural textural variation in hair.
physical_description.build: Broad-shouldered and heavily muscled through the chest and core, carrying weight with deliberate solidity rather than softness. Their frame suggests functional strength — the kind built through labor or combat training, not aesthetics.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with silver-gray threading at the temples
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back tight, secured with a utilitarian clip. Pragmatic rather than fashionable.
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-brown with golden and olive undertones—the natural blend of Eastern European, South Asian, and Sub-Saharan ancestry combined with Pacific Islander influence. Rich depth that darkens slightly in shadow but luminous in direct light.
physical_description.complexion: Face is angular and weathered with prominent cheekbones and defined jaw structure typical of the ancestry blend. Minimal grooming beyond the functional — no visible cosmetics. Skin shows the wear of stress and environmental exposure. Faint scar tissue pattern along the left jawline. Nose structure reflects mixed heritage—refined bridge with subtle width.
distinguishing_marks: Thin, pale scar running from left temple to cheekbone, roughly 8cm, acquired years ago
Visible chrome seam along the sternum where synthetic lungs were installed — a deliberate choice to leave unsealed, letting metallic silver show beneath worn clothing
Callused palms and scarred knuckles consistent with hands-on equipment work
physical_description.visible_augmentations: The most obvious modification is the chrome-lined sternum access port left partially visible — a statement of non-concealment. The synthetic lung system can be heard as a faint mechanical whisper when they breathe deeply, especially in quiet spaces. No visible limb chrome, but the way they move suggests internal reinforcement or joint augmentation.
physical_description.posture_movement: Carries themselves with the controlled tension of someone always assessing threat vectors. Movements are economical and deliberate — no wasted motion. They favor stillness over fidgeting; when they do move, it's purposeful. Their default expression is neutral to the point of opacity, a learned defense mechanism.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 utilitarian. Worn synthetic jacket with reinforced seams and multiple pockets, the kind designed for function rather than fashion. Underneath, thermal layers in muted grays and blacks. Cargo pants with tool loops. Boots are heavy, practical, scuffed from actual use. Nothing new or shiny — everything has been broken in through real work. No corporate branding, but the gear quality suggests someone with steady income and practical priorities.
